svg.title: #1155-B Foxglove keyboard grant: the ask dialog, the header lines and the permission rows, light and dark (drawn mockup, not an egui render)
svg.text: #1155-B · Foxglove keyboard grant (proposed) · LIGHT THEME
Drawn mockup with the hub theme tokens, not an egui render. All hub-drawn: Foxglove never draws its own grant.
1 The ask: on the user's own Turn on of Foxglove in Modules (first time only)
Hideout
Modules
Foxglove
Off · installed separately
Arete
On
Let Foxglove handle your keyboard in Hideout?
Apps you have allowed to use your keyboard will reach it through
Foxglove. With this on, Foxglove can do these for them:
Keyboard
See which keyboard is connected, its battery, layer
Lights
Change its colours, effects and brightness
Art and screens
Change what the keyboard's screens show
Actions
Run its key actions, switch Foxglove profiles,
pick the keyboard in front (never reset or bootloader)
Each app still needs its own permission. Nothing leaves this PC.
You can turn this off any time in Modules, Foxglove.
Only for this copy of Foxglove:
C:\Users\…\Programs\Foxglove\foxglove.exe
If the program file changes or moves, Hideout asks again.
Allow
Not now
Focus on Not now · Esc = Not now
2 No modal at start: Foxglove page header line (upgrade, autostart, file changed)
Foxglove needs your OK to handle your keyboard for other apps
Until you allow it, apps that use your keyboard through Hideout can't reach it.
Review…
Not now
Foxglove changed since you allowed it
Its program file is new or was moved, so Hideout turned keyboard sharing off.
Review…
Not now
Review… opens the dialog in 1 with the reason on top. The live page stays usable; no focus is taken.
3 Afterwards: Modules, Foxglove, Permissions (one hub-drawn row)
Handle your keyboard for other apps
Keyboard, lights, art and screens, actions. Allowed 12 Nov.
On
Turn off
Handle your keyboard for other apps
You turned this off. Foxglove keeps running on its own.
Off
Turn on…
Handle your keyboard for other apps
Not allowed yet.
Off
Turn on…
Handle your keyboard for other apps
Foxglove's program file changed on 12 Nov.
Asks again
Review…
Turn off acts at once, no confirm (the safe direction). Turn on… and Review… always open the dialog.
4 After Turn off: Foxglove keeps running, with less
Keeps working
Foxglove's own window, its keyboard summary on the Foxglove page,
and what you allowed before (lights page, overlay, tray panel).
Stops
Other apps and the foxglove command can't read or change the keyboard
through Hideout. To them it looks as if Foxglove weren't running.
Why not stop it
Stopping it would take the keyboard away from you, not just from other apps.
Screen reader: "Handle your keyboard for other apps, On. Turn off, button." A change is announced once (polite).
Contrast (WCAG, from tokens, light / dark): text 17.1 / 13.0, muted 7.3 / 5.8, accent 5.2 / 6.4,
on-accent 5.2 / 8.0, attention 6.2 / 9.2, ok 6.3 / 8.4, muted on chrome 6.2 / 6.5. State is always a word too.
